mapper.sql: e.id, e.appointment_id, a.patient_id, COALESCE(a.booking_patient_name,p.name) AS patient_name, e.doctor_id, COALESCE(a.booking_doctor_name,d.name) AS doctor_name, COALESCE(a.booking_department_name,dep.name) AS department_name, COALESCE(a.booking_clinic_room_name,room.name) AS clinic_room_name, sl.work_date, sl.start_time, sl.end_time, e.status, e.checked_in_at, e.started_at, e.completed_at, e.version, CASE WHEN source_a.id IS NOT NULL THEN source_e.id ELSE NULL END AS source_encounter_id, source_a.id AS source_appointment_id,source_sl.work_date AS source_work_date, (a.booking_snapshot_at IS NOT NULL) AS has_booking_snapshot

med_encounter e JOIN med_appointment a ON a.id = e.appointment_id JOIN med_patient p ON p.id = a.patient_id JOIN med_slot sl ON sl.id = a.slot_id JOIN med_schedule s ON s.id = sl.schedule_id JOIN med_doctor d ON d.id = e.doctor_id JOIN med_department dep ON dep.id = d.department_id JOIN med_clinic_room room ON room.id = s.clinic_room_id LEFT JOIN med_encounter source_e ON source_e.id=a.source_encounter_id AND source_e.status='COMPLETED' LEFT JOIN med_appointment source_a ON source_a.id=source_e.appointment_id AND source_a.patient_id=a.patient_id LEFT JOIN med_slot source_sl ON source_sl.id=source_a.slot_id
